name: Runnr
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && python3 -m venv api/.venv && api/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && api/.venv/bin/pip install -r api/requirements.txt

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Runnr FastAPI backend (broker sync, auth, quotes, stats). Docs at http://localhost:8090/docs. SQLite falls back to /tmp/runnr.db when no /data volume is mounted.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static PWA frontend. Open http://localhost:8080 — on localhost the app auto-targets the local API at http://localhost:8090.
